ShortDescription.Value: Create custom bridges from available roads and tracks, with 3D previews and supported double-deck styles.

Publish.LongDescription:
Bridge Builder combines available roads and tracks with supported bridge styles.
- Isometric 3D previews before creation. - Independent upper and lower networks for supported double-deck styles. - Search, filter, rename and manage generated bridges. - Road Builder compatibility is optional, not a required dependency.
Back up your save before deleting a generated bridge: deletion also removes its placed instances. Available styles depend on installed content and supported prototypes.
Source: https://github.com/Chengxuan-He/CS2BridgeBuilder
